questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns drivers that bicycles may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means "Stop." Come to a complete stop, let traffic and pedestrians pass if they have the right-of-way, then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Bicyclists use hand and arm signals because they don't have turn signals. A left arm stretched straight out means the bicyclist is turning left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is illegal and unsafe to make a left turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill slope is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on the road.
There is a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns drivers about winding roads with multiple curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a full stop and look in all directions for traffic before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead with a road joining from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a diagonal line over a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means parking is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
May not proceed until it changes to green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. Come to a complete stop before the intersection. Let other traffic and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about services. They tell you about rest areas, food, gas, and hospitals nearby.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that wet pavement is slippery and dangerous. Slow down because it takes longer to stop on wet roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow backgrounds. This sign tells you the road may be slippery when wet. Slow down and be careful because your vehicle may be harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign shows how tall the space is under a bridge or overpass. In this case, it is 12 feet, 6 inches high. Tall vehicles must not enter if they are taller than this measurement.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped orange signs warn of hazards in construction or maintenance areas. Slow down and watch for workers and equipment.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the right lane is ending soon. Be ready to merge with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you about a T intersection ahead. Be prepared to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs tell you to slow down at intersections. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that wet pavement makes the road slippery. Drive carefully and slowly in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means this lane leaves the freeway and does not continue through the interchange. If you stay in this lane, you must exit. You can change lanes to stay on the freeway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending. Get ready to merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that bicycles cross this road. Watch for cyclists.
